required_fields: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with GTF3C3-related neurodevelopmental disorder (OMIM #621201), including numerator and denominator per cohort (not just percentage), exact wording from the paper, and corresponding standard HPO term
PMID or DOI citation attached to each reported cohort and phenotype frequency
Most discriminating clinical findings present in most affected individuals but uncommon in overlapping disorders, along with the names of those disorders and the confidence level of the distinction
Findings looked for and found absent in affected individuals whose presence would argue against the diagnosis
Assessment of whether phenotype differs by variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Any findings where one paper reports presence and another explicitly contradicts it
